_comment: Leduc Hold'em locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Never translate the action tokens ('[check]', '[bet]', '[call]', '[raise]', '[fold]'), the card labels (J/Q/K), or numeric chip/pot amounts.

_slots.{winner}: The player number who wins the showdown
_slots.{busted}: The player number who ran out of chips
_slots.{card}: A card label: J, Q or K
_slots.{legal}: A comma-separated list of legal action tokens, e.g. '[check]', '[bet]'
_slots.{allowed}: The set of currently legal move names, e.g. {'call', 'fold'}
_slots.{reason}: A pre-rendered outcome reason, inserted verbatim

player_prompt.intro:
Wena ndi Muthandeni {player_id} ku Leduc Hold'em.
Khumana na chipimo chimuthu kama '[check]', '[bet]', '[call]', '[raise]', kana '[fold]' apo ndi nthawi yako.
Makumi ya malipiro gha chipimo: 2 chipu zamu ya kwanza, 4 chipu zamu ya pili (max 2 kupandisha kwa mzunguko).

board.new_hand: ### Mkono wapya - kadi yako ya siri: {card}

outcome.banks: {reason} Makumi ya banki apo: Muthandeni 0: {b0}; Muthandeni 1: {b1}
